name: Next Beat
author: Project Σ
description: Ideas for where the story goes next, written by your own model from the open chat: buttons above the composer, or a window of its own, each a kind of move (a spread of different turns, higher stakes, a quiet beat, a reveal, a knock at the door, a jump ahead) or a genre, a Director for scenes and steps you sketch, and Surprise Me, a hidden event the narrator brings in a few messages later. Insert a suggestion into the composer or send it. Ships off; switch it on to use it. Inspired by Pathweaver for SillyTavern by mattjaybe (MIT), with thanks to its author.
